_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, byte-deterministic). Metrics come from the LinkedIn Marketing adAnalytics 'Metrics Available' table (li-lms-2026-06 moniker); the pivot dimensions come from the Analytics/Statistics finder 'pivot' enum; the Revenue Attribution metrics come from the attributedRevenueMetrics finder (flattened).
_derivation.expansion_rule: Every metric in the Metrics Available table is emitted verbatim as a 'metric' field. Four provider tokens are RENAMED to the manifest's canonical field_id and carry the provider token as source_field so the manifest<->catalog gate stays green: costInLocalCurrency->cost, externalWebsiteConversions->conversions, leadGenerationMailContactInfoShares->leads; the date dimension is field_id 'date' with source_field 'dateRange'. impressions/clicks are identical on both sides. Every Analytics/Statistics finder pivot enum value is emitted ONCE as a parameterised dimension field_id 'pivot_<ENUM>' (source_field 'pivot:<ENUM>'); the connector materialises the structural campaign_id / campaign_group_id ids from the pivot URNs.
_derivation.count_divergence: Metric total (125) is well below the Supermetrics 101-metric figure only in the sense that the two catalogs count differently: Supermetrics itemises fewer viral/document/event families than the official 202506 schema. Dimension total (28) is intentionally below Supermetrics' 110: Supermetrics enumerates every demographic pivot VALUE permutation (per-country, per-industry, per-seniority, ...) as a distinct column, whereas this catalog declares each pivot ONCE as a parameterised dimension. Enumerating pivot values is out of scope -- they are query outputs resolved per account at run time (URN resolution), not catalog fields, and would be non-deterministic.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/linkedin-ads-fields.md -o server/modules/linkedin-ads/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: LinkedIn adAnalytics takes a fields= list (metrics + pivots) over a date range on the selected sponsored account. The probe batches up to 20 fields per analytics request over a 1-day window; a batch that returns an invalid_request is bisected so the exact rejected field is captured.

pivot_compatibility._note: LinkedIn adAnalytics accepts exactly ONE pivot per request (AI-53 verifie 2026-07-19). Selecting >1 pivot_* dimension is refused BEFORE any API call with an InvalidRequestError. The pivot value is the ENUM portion after 'pivot_' (e.g. pivot_MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2 -> MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2). The default pivot CAMPAIGN is applied when no pivot_* dimension is selected.

excluded_sections.REVENUE ATTRIBUTION: Requires the separate attributedRevenueMetrics finder, not the adAnalytics fields param.

_tier_note: pivot_* fields demoted to standard (25.9): LinkedIn accepts exactly ONE pivot per request, so a core tier would make the tier-core default selection carry 14 pivots and auto-refuse. They stay exposed and selectable one at a time.
